turns.user: Tìm repo GitHub về RAG agent
turns.assistant_text:
Here are some GitHub repositories related to RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) agents:

1. **[RagaAI-Catalyst](https://github.com/raga-ai-hub/RagaAI-Catalyst)**  
   - **Description**: Python SDK for Agent AI Observability, Monitoring and Evaluation Framework. Includes features like agent, LLM, and tools tracing, debugging multi-agentic systems, self-hosted dashboard, and advanced analytics with timeline and execution graph view.  
   - **Stars**: 16,140 | **Forks**: 3,576 | **Language**: Python

2. **[awesome-llm-apps](https://github.com/Shubhamsaboo/awesome-llm-apps)**  
   - **Description**: 100+ AI Agents, Agent Skills, and RAG Apps - Free and Open Source.  
   - **Stars**: 128,566 | **Forks**: 18,978 | **Language**: Python

3. **[hello-agents](https://github.com/datawhalechina/hello-agents)**  
   - **Description**: A tutorial on building intelligent agents from scratch.  
   - **Stars**: 69,253 | **Forks**: 8,628 | **Language**: Python

4. **[ragflow](https://github.com/infiniflow/ragflow)**  
   - **Description**: RAGFlow is a leading open-source Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) engine that fuses cutting-edge RAG with Agent capabilities to create a superior context layer for LLMs.  
   - **Stars**: 86,294 | **Forks**: 10,122 | **Language**: Go

5. **[production-agentic-rag-course](https://github.com/jamwithai/production-agentic-rag-course)**  
   - **Description**: Course on building agentic RAG systems.  
   - **Stars**: 8,167 | **Forks**: 1,812 | **Language**: Python

6. **[RAG-Agents-Accelerator](https://github.com/pablomarin/RAG-Agents-Accelerator)**  
   - **Description**: Azure AI Search + Azure OpenAI Accelerator to build Agents.  
   - **Stars**: 420 | **Forks**: 973 | **Language**: Jupyter Notebook

7. **[agentic-rag-for-dummies](https://github.com/GiovanniPasq/agentic-rag-for-dummies)**  
   - **Description**: A modular Agentic RAG built with LangGraph — learn Retrieval-Augmented Generation Agents in minutes.  
   - **Stars**: 3,813 | **Forks**: 488 | **Language**: Jupyter Notebook

8. **[OpenViking](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking)**  
   - **Description**: Self-evolving Context Database for AI Agents. Unify Agent Memory, Knowledge RAG, and Skills.  
   - **Stars**: 27,586 | **Forks**: 2,163 | **Language**: Python

9. **[ragent](https://github.com/nageoffer/ragent)**  
   - **Description**: Enterprise-level Agentic RAG intelligent agent covering document parsing, multi-retrieval, intent recognition, question rewriting, session memory, and deep thinking.  
   - **Stars**: 3,353 | **Forks**: 672 | **Language**: Java

These repositories cover a range of functionalities and frameworks related to RAG agents.

Since Spotify’s early days, just nine songs have topped the platform as the most-streamed track worldwide. The story began with Viva La Vida by Coldplay and saw extended reigns from Human by The Killers and Shape of You by Ed Sheeran — both holding the crown for over 1,000 days. Below is the full timeline, showing when each track led the platform. [...] ↓ Skip to Main Content
